customers_say: Customers find the water purifier's installation quick and perfect, and appreciate its elegant design and functionality, particularly for small families. The water taste is good, with customers noting they can control it according to their water source. The product's reliability and value for money receive mixed feedback - while some say it works perfectly and is good for its price, others report it stops working properly and consider it a waste of money. The customer experience and service also get mixed reviews, with some praising the service while others find it terrible.

reviews.title: ### Extremely Disappointing After-Sales Service from Aquaguard###
reviews.body: ### Extremely Disappointing After-Sales Service from Aquaguard The product worked well for the first four months. However, during the fifth month, the TDS level started increasing, and by the end of the fifth month, it had crossed 120. This is when I raised my first service complaint. A technician visited a few days later, carried out some checks, and assured me that the issue would resolve and the purifier would work fine. reviews.body: Good water purifier with effective filtration. The water tastes clean and fresh, and the purifier looks stylish. It is easy to use and the overall performance has been good so far. Installation was also smooth. Happy with the purchase.
